title: Atom valuations on a valid encoded instance
statement: Let $C_w,c_w$ be natural numbers, and let $x,U,t_w,a_w,j_w,p_w$ be Boolean words. Suppose $|x|+2<2^{C_w(|x|+1)^{c_w}}$ and the length-validity atom evaluates to true on the nested pair encoding of these words. Then the function assigning each atom its evaluation on that encoding is exactly the numerical valuation obtained from the encoded time and auxiliary counters, the input length and index, the marked word derived from $U$, and the input bit predicate, with answer atoms evaluated by the bounded-time answer function.
hypotheses_covered: C_w and c_w are natural numbers
x, U, t_w, a_w, j_w, and p_w are Boolean words
The length-validity atom evaluates to true on the nested pair encoding
